subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should the removed `steipete/bird` package gain an explicit retired/unavailable state, be republished from a valid Bird upstream, or remain a generic not-found record?
rationale: Source and live checks prove the broken metadata is no longer served, but they cannot establish whether silent removal was intentional or what package relationship the namespace owner intends.

options.title: Mark Bird unavailable
options.body: Keep installation disabled and expose a clear owner-approved retired or broken-upstream status for the old package.

options.title: Republish corrected Bird
options.body: Require a valid canonical repository, downloadable release asset, updated package metadata, and install smoke proof before restoring the package.

options.title: Accept generic removal
options.body: Treat the current not-found response as the final lifecycle policy without Bird-specific messaging.

recommendation.title: Mark Bird unavailable
recommendation.body: Keep installation disabled and expose a clear owner-approved retired or broken-upstream status for the old package.

likelyOwner.reason: The namespace owner is the best available authority on whether Bird has a valid upstream or is intentionally retired.
